_comment: Provenance for every web sound effect. Generated by scripts/build_web_sfx.py from the same MANIFEST the Saturn build uses (examples/coup/assets/convert_sfx.py), so the two clients cannot disagree about what a sound is or where it came from. PLACEHOLDER AUDIO: replacing one is a data change - drop the new WAV over examples/coup/assets/sfx_src/<name>.wav, update its MANIFEST provenance, re-run both converters. Paths are relative to this file; never absolute, because an absolute /assets/ URL resolves against the LIVE site from a /staging/ page.
